title: More spelling errors
description:
Also, ran checking script through cProfile and fixed some
obvious inefficiencies

notes.body:
added 1 commit
  • a1a40759 - More spelling errors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22096/diffs?diff_id=1544168789&start_sha=969f1427076757a5315b0a49395b827aefb2d462)
Might need to move this _after_ the replacements of `%u`, `%d`, `%s` otherwise I think they will never match.

changed this line in [version 3 of the diff](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22096/diffs?diff_id=1544190496&start_sha=a1a40759e71ae3b47652c678b45b1adc53708af8#55c055f057d3c087609b8d41a0a9fa2baa93b1dc_202_202)
Thanks Darius, have changed the order!

added 1 commit
  • f7adfd2c - More spelling errors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22096/diffs?diff_id=1544190496&start_sha=a1a40759e71ae3b47652c678b45b1adc53708af8)

added 1 commit
  • d2b28aec - More spelling errors
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/22096/diffs?diff_id=1544300490&start_sha=f7adfd2c5d4b8ea4412a5fa8a191192e86150db6)
enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
cancelled automatic add to merge train

More spelling errors

Also, ran checking script through cProfile and fixed some
